original.target_description: Single unnumbered experiment, not a labeled Study 2: attempted emotion regulation after an upsetting movie. The control condition is one arm of the reported suppression-versus-control manipulation-check t test, not a separate within-condition inferential test.

n.sample_role: Participants in the analytic suppression and control groups, respectively; both groups enter the reported manipulation-check t test.
n.exclusions: 7 of 40 excluded from all analyses: extensive EEG artifacts (2), equipment malfunction (1), excessive incongruent Stroop error rates >40% (3), outlying EEG scores (1).
n.location: p. 934 (PDF p. 2), Method, Subjects and Design
n.quote: emotion suppression (n 5 15) or no emotion suppression (control; n 5 18).

replication.target_description: Single unnumbered experiment, not a labeled Study 2: attempted emotion regulation measured by two items after a sad film. The control group is included in a three-group omnibus ANOVA (control, suppression, reappraisal). No separate within-control-condition test or effect size is reported.

n.sample_role: Participants retained in control, suppression, and reappraisal groups, respectively, for the omnibus manipulation-check ANOVA (residual df 44).
n.exclusions: Eleven excluded: incongruent Stroop error rates >30% (4), excessive EEG artifacts removing all error trials (4), fewer than six error trials after artifact rejection (3).
n.location: PDF pp. 3–4, Methods, Participants; full HTML Participants paragraph
n.quote: control (n = 15, mean age 23.07 years, 8 women), suppression (n = 16, mean age 22.50 years, 8 women), and reappraisal (n = 16, mean age 21.25 years, 7 women).

notes: Both references and full-text titles verified. Neither paper labels a Study 2; study identifiers cannot be reconciled. The supplied group-specific descriptions do not identify distinct inferential tests. Closest located manipulation-check tests are retained with target_match false: the same original two-group contrast and replication three-group omnibus test apply to both IDs. Original reports p_rep = .97 (a replication-probability statistic), not a conventional p value; no p was converted. The original PDF text maps equals signs to 5; source quotes retain that frozen parse. Replication partial eta-squared and p refer to the same omnibus ANOVA; pairwise p values are not substituted. Group sample counts are printed retained analytic counts, not a computed total. No explicit author verdict about replication success of this particular manipulation-check effect was found; reported_success is null.
